coordinate_and_tau_policy: reuse each case's sealed original DS1 shared_time winner, selected using randomized TRAIN rows before held evaluation
identity_policy: select each track's hard candidate using randomized TRAIN rows only at the fixed coordinate and tau
rate_schedule_policy: run every predeclared symmetric bound unconditionally; no earlier result and no HELD result may stop, widen, narrow, or otherwise alter the schedule

global_profile.grid_policy: for each TRAIN source and bound, choose enough equal intervals that max(abs(TRAIN age_h))*delta_rate <= 0.05 seconds; evaluate an additional half-step scan before refinement
global_profile.selection: evaluate the source-specific coarse and half-step grids, both endpoints, and zero; bounded-refine every half-grid local minimum; select the lowest TRAIN objective with deterministic absolute-rate then signed-rate tie breaks
global_profile.ambiguity_policy: flag a profile when the best-versus-second distinct candidate objective gap is <= 1e-6*max(1,abs(best objective)); an ambiguous +/-0.50 profile blocks the prospective basin
global_profile.legacy_comparator: also record one historical whole-interval bounded minimize_scalar result, never use it for selection

mask_authority: receipt-bound prepared_evidence.tracks[].training_mask loaded by reports/2026_09_24_ds1/run.py::make_engine and preserved by reports/2026_09_24_ds1_orbit_arm/run.py::prepare
scoring: cap-800 squared RMS per track, occupied-second weighting within session, equal mean across the six sessions in each case; unsupported TRAIN identities remain at the cap
held_policy: all fits at all bounds complete before HELD scoring; HELD rows may only score frozen arms and cannot determine source membership, coordinate, tau, identity, CFO, rate, optimizer calls, bounds, fallback, stopping, or the basin go/no
boundary_policy: active when bound-minus-absolute-rate is no greater than max(5*xatol, 32*machine_epsilon*max(1,bound))
exact_gate: direct SGP4 replay maximum absolute surrogate error <= 0.2 Hz for zero and every widened-rate arm
prospective_basin_gate: the +/-0.50 arm alone is eligible to authorize a prospective basin: go only if both groups have converged TRAIN profiles, zero active fits, zero ambiguous best/second profiles, complete half-step verification, and a passing exact-replay gate; +/-1.0 is diagnostic only and randomized HELD is reported but neither is a decision input
launch_policy: write one fixed-point widening audit only; do not launch a geographic basin
interpretation: randomized within-track predictive regression evidence at two previously sealed points, not a geographic estimate, new-session transfer, or untouched validation
